usedFor: Zernio holds posts, and Eden AI checks them when “New Post” runs “AI Generated Content Detection”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Post” in Zernio, then “AI Generated Content Detection” in Eden AI
bestTemplate.why: Each new post is screened for AI-written text, so you see which ones need a closer look.

watchOut: “New Post” in Zernio is polling over a time window, so set the window wide enough to catch every post.
